title: A great day at Montserrat
text:
Pedro was truly an awesome guide. His knowledge about Barcelona and Montserrat was impressive. He had the perfect attitude for us - upbeat, attentive and engaged but he knew when to give us a moment to linger at a site or take in the atmosphere. He gave us great insider information as we went into places where he did not accompany us and was thoroughly familiar with every aspect of the area. 

At the end of our time together, he even recommended a place for lunch and without us asking called ahead to make a reservation for us.

title: Very nice
text: Montserrat is a must see. We did the private tour and it’s worth it. our driver and tour guide Pao is amazing and very kind and knowledgeable.  The experience is great. A beautiful place
author: analea_p

title: Fred was an amazing tour...
text: Fred was an amazing tour guide. He gave us lots of information even though we could not see the mountain due to poor weather.
author: Bridget_A

title: Great guide; Great Tour
text: We had an absolute great time. Our guide, Horacio, was great.  He picked us up from our AIRBNB right on time and we enjoyed some interesting conversation on the way to Montserrat. He was also very knowledgeable about Montserrat and escorted us all the way to The Cross of Saint Michael where we took some great pictures.  The views are amazing. We also had tickets to enter the Basilica to see the black Madonna. If visiting Barcelona, this is a must visit.  It takes about one hour to get there and I strongly recommend an early departure to the area to avoid long lines to enter and the huge crowds
author: richardwR6317UE

title: Unforgettable trip to Montserrat
text: Excellent guided tour by Pau, sharing his personal experiences and knowledge of Catalonia. It was a great tour with incredible views and special moments to remember in the future.
author: JOSE_P

title: It's worth having a guide...
text: It's worth having a guide pick you up from where you are staying and return you afterwards.  Pau was an awesome tour guide...informative, flexible and relational. He was AMAZING!
author: Gregory_G

title: Spend an enjoyable day with Pau, your awesome tour guide!
text: Pau was the most wonderful tour guide! He was personable, informative and flexible. It felt like we were spending the day with a great friend.
author: BarbG138

title: Must book!
text: This was a wonderful tour! Pedro was a fantastic guide, we learned so much about Montserrat. Even though it was pouring rain we still had a great time and saw and learned so much. Would definitely recommend this tour!
author: Rachel_B

title: Funicular fun
text:
This was an excellent experience that I highly recommend. Our tour guide, Andy, was knowledgeable, courteous, and fun to be with. The views from the monastery were spectacular, especially in the early morning fog.  Our tour started at 8 am. 

We had a wonderful time — a perfect way to end our stay in Barcelona!

P.S.  in a review of the Barcelona food tour, I mistakenly identified our guide as Andy. His name is Miguel.
author: Lucy_F
